newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Papua New Guinea army chief to step down - aide.
newsitem.headline: Papua New Guinea army chief to step down - aide.

text.p: Papua New Guinea defence force commander Brigadier-General Jerry Singirok, sacked late on Monday after demanding that the nation's prime minister step down, has agreed to stand down, a senior military aide said on Tuesday.

Singirok will stand down once he has received official notice of his sacking from the nation's governor-general, Sigirok's military aide, Lieutenant-Colonel Joseph Fabila told Reuters by telephone from the PNG capital Port Moresby.
"The commander is still waiting for the official writs to come down from the governor-general's office," Fabila said.
"He then plans to hold an official press conference some time after he receives the official writs."
Fabila described the situation in Port Moresby as calm but tense and said Singirok had urged restraint on his troops.
